title: no_grad or detach?
summary: Where gradients stop in a target network update.

choices.text: Wrap the whole step, including `loss.backward()`, in `torch.no_grad()` so the target network gets no gradients.
Set `target_net.eval()`, which stops the target network from recording gradients.
Compute `target` under `torch.no_grad()` or call `.detach()` on it; both stop gradients there.
Call `target.requires_grad_(False)` after computing it, which removes it from the existing graph.
